verdict.rationale: Zep documents adding conversation messages via thread.add_messages, which ingests them into the user-level Context Graph. It also documents retrieving them later through graph search that combines semantic similarity with BM25, or through a Context Block. Because the graph is held per user rather than per thread, context carries across sessions. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of recall quality, explicit documentation of cross-thread/session retrieval behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add memories from conversations and retrieve them later with semantic search, so context persists across sessions

citations.quote: Chat messages are added to threads using `thread.add_messages`, which both adds those messages to the thread history and ingests those messages into the user-level knowledge graph.
Zep graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search. Semantic search finds conceptual matches, and full-text search finds exact terms.
The integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve data from the user's Context Graph.
Zep will perform a user graph search right after persisting the data and return the context relevant to the recently added messages.
